title: heliomeris hispida
intro: Heliomeris hispida, commonly known as prairie rosinweed or rosinweed, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and pain, and is used to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of heliomeris hispida include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpene saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential health benefits.
